test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

After hours of discussion, the team ______ at the same conclusion.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Arrived'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence **'arrived**' is the correct word to fill in.
 
• We use the verb** arrive** to talk about **'coming to' **or **'reaching'** a place where a journey ends.
 
• **Arrived** is always followed by the preposition** at** or** in.**
 
• **Example - ***I do not **arrive at** the conclusion that it was wilful.*

Thus, *​ *After seeing the above explanation we can say that the correct answer is** After hours of discussion, the team arrived at the same conclusion.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss why the other given options are incorrect:
 
 
• **'Reached'** is never followed by a preposition.
 
• **'Came'** itself is used as a preposition, so we cannot use it with **'at'.**
 
• **'Attained at**' will be used when getting something after a lot of effort.
